alert_camera_body: %1$s camera was opened at %2$s. Android doesn't let apps see which other app opened it.
alert_lockscreen_body: Unlock the phone to see details.
alert_mic_body_generic: An app opened the microphone at %1$s. Android didn't report which one.
alert_sms_flagged_body: A message from %1$s matched your block list.
alert_untrusted_call_body: %1$s is not in your family vault. Call was silenced.
alert_untrusted_sms_body: %1$s is not in your family vault.
blocked_no_numbers_added: No numbers added yet. Tap + above to block a specific number on this device.
channel_silent_background_desc: Required Android notifications for pocket detection and mic/camera lock. Hidden from the status bar to avoid clutter.
dash_awaiting_toggle_detail: Turn on "Silence calls not in vault" to activate.
dash_cannot_monitor_other_apps: This app cannot monitor other apps' microphone or camera use.
dash_exit_duress_body: You'll be returned to the lock screen. Unlock with your real credential to see the real vault.
dash_protection_active_detail: Only trusted contacts can reach you.
dash_sos_add_contact_body: The SOS button alerts every trusted contact. Add at least one in the Contacts tab to use this.
dash_tap_see_limits: This app cannot monitor other apps' microphone or camera use. Tap to see all platform limits.
dash_week_empty: No blocked activity in the last 7 days. Everything's quiet.
dash_week_fmt: This week we blocked %1$d call(s) and %2$d text(s) for you.
duress_decoy_opened: Decoy vault opened. Silent SOS sent.
events_audit_tampered_detail: The event log hash chain is broken. An event may have been edited.
language_restart_note: Some screens update immediately; others refresh on next app open.
legal_auto_renew: Auto-renews at the price shown. Cancel anytime in Google Play Subscriptions.
legal_no_server: OnlyTrusted has no server. Everything stays on this device.
mic_watcher_body: Tap to mute, or dismiss if this was expected.
mic_watcher_channel_desc: Notifies you when another app starts using the microphone.
monitor_text_both: Microphone and camera are in use. OnlyTrusted is watching but not recording.
monitor_text_camera: Camera is in use. OnlyTrusted is watching but not recording.
monitor_text_idle: Watching mic and camera. Nothing suspicious right now.
monitor_text_mic: Microphone is in use. OnlyTrusted is watching but not recording.
onb_consent_subtitle: To use OnlyTrusted, you must review and confirm the following.
onb_email_detail: Stored on this device only. OnlyTrusted does not have a server, so your email is never transmitted anywhere.
onb_limits: I have read and understood the honest limits
onb_limits_detail: I understand what OnlyTrusted can do, what it cannot do, and any limitations on Android.
onb_own_device: I own this device or am authorized to use it
onb_own_device_detail: I have the right to use and configure this device.
onb_passkey_detail: Face / fingerprint becomes your primary unlock — phishing-proof, nothing to type. Uses hardware-backed Keystore / StrongBox; biometric never leaves this device.
onb_pin_detail: Backup unlock for when your Passkey can't be presented. PBKDF2-hashed with 100k iterations before storing — we can't read it back.
onb_welcome_tagline:
A safer, quieter phone
starts here.
passkey_setup_subtitle: Confirm with Face / fingerprint — hardware-bound, on-device.
sensor_privacy_accessibility_description: Listens for a double-press of volume-down to instantly cut mic + camera. OnlyTrusted does NOT read screen content, inject touches, or exfiltrate any data from this service.
sensor_privacy_channel_desc: Keeps the lock-watcher service running so OnlyTrusted can toggle mic + camera when the screen locks.
sensor_privacy_notif_body: Watching screen state to mute mic + block camera when locked. No audio or video is recorded.
sensor_privacy_notif_body_both: Microphone and camera are in use. OnlyTrusted is watching but not recording.
sensor_privacy_notif_body_camera: Camera is in use. OnlyTrusted is watching but not recording.
sensor_privacy_notif_body_mic: Microphone is in use. OnlyTrusted is watching but not recording.
settings_language_region_subtitle: Choose your region, country and preferred language.
shield_text_running: Shield watermark on. Captures taken now will carry your session code.
vault_delete_body: This permanently removes the contact and all encrypted details.
